sections.markdown:
## C - California Driver's Handbook Section One: The California Driver License

FACT_ID: sec01-F01 | anchor: A01
A California driver's license lets you drive on public roads [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F02 | anchor: A01
Before California grants you a driver's license, you must pass both a knowledge test and a behind-the-wheel drive test drawn from this handbook [A01].
Why it matters: both tests draw on this handbook, so every later section is testable.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F03 | anchor: A01
Your license must match the kind of vehicle you drive [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F04 | anchor: A01
Most drivers need a noncommercial Class C driver's license [A01].
Why it matters: Class C is the default target license for the learners this product serves.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F05 | anchor: A01
Driving commercial vehicles, motorcycles, or other vehicle types calls for a different license class [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F06 | anchor: A01
Starting in May 2025, a driver's license or ID card must be REAL ID compliant to board domestic flights [A01].
Why it matters: travel and access rules are the most practical payoff of this section.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F07 | anchor: A01
A REAL ID is also needed to enter military bases [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F08 | anchor: A01
Most federal facilities likewise require a REAL ID for entry [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F09 | anchor: A01
California issues driver's licenses to every resident, no matter their immigration status [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F10 | anchor: A01
Information about becoming an organ and tissue donor is available at donateLIFEcalifornia.org [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F11 | anchor: A01
Requirements and benefits of a Veteran designation are explained at dmv.ca.gov/veterans [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F12 | anchor: A01
Identification cards go to eligible people of any age for proving identity, and they never authorize driving [A01].
Why it matters: learners often confuse ID cards with driving privileges.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F13 | anchor: A01
An ID applicant must show an identity document, residency documents, and a social security number [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F14 | anchor: A01
Details of which vehicles a Class C license covers are posted at dmv.ca.gov/dl [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F15 | anchor: A01
You can learn about applying for a REAL ID at dmv.ca.gov/realid [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F16 | anchor: A01
ID card applications, acceptable documents, and reduced-fee, no-fee, or senior ID card details are handled at dmv.ca.gov/id-cards [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]
